### What changed?
Describe the player-facing or engineering change.

### Why?
What problem or opportunity does this address?

### DreamShield checklist
- [ ] I ran node --check game.js.
- [ ] I ran python3 tools/validate_dreambound.py --mode all.
- [ ] I did not add secrets, credentials, private endpoints or production tokens.
- [ ] I did not add analytics, ads, public chat, external child-facing links or remote content.
- [ ] Any new network/account/multiplayer capability includes an explicit security/privacy design review.
- [ ] Child-facing language and controls remain appropriate for ages 4–8.
- [ ] The README/changelog is updated if the shipped feature surface changed.
- [ ] I tested save compatibility if profile/state structures changed.

### Evidence
Add screenshots, test output, or concise verification notes. Do not present mockups as shipped runtime evidence.

### Security impact
None / Low / Medium / High, with a short explanation.
